[[The Gangs of Kaineng (Hard mode)]] | map = [[image:The Gangs of Kaineng.jpg|250px]] }} Fight your way into the [[Jade Brotherhood]]'s [[Jade Brotherhood's guild hall|guild hall]] to capture a [[Jade Brotherhood Text|text]] containing the identity of the gang's [[Reisen the Phoenix|leader]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat [[Ganshu the Scribe]], and obtain the Jade Brotherhood Text. * See [[Xan Hei]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,000 [[Experience]] *1,000 [[Gold]] *[[Ministerial Commendation]] ==Walkthrough== Leave from [[The Marketplace]] and head west, fighting through several large groups of Jade Brotherhood. You will receive many allies in the form of members of the [[Ministry of Purity]] as well as some regular [[Canthan Peasant]]s. The Peasants are not very useful, but provide excellent fodder for [[minion masters]]. Upon reaching Ganshu the Scribe, his group and one more behind him will initially be friendly; after some brief dialogue they will turn hostile. Defeat Ganshu and pick up the [[Jade Brotherhood Text]] to complete the quest. Alternatively, leave from [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]] and head north. This route takes a few more minutes, but it is safer. There will be some regular [[Am Fah]] mobs and [[Mantid]]s along the way, but nothing dangerous. Once you reach the island stronghold, a large brawl will already be going on between some Peasants and Ministry forces; you can either try to save some by rushing in head first, or forget about them and play it safe, pulling the Jade groups apart for easier killing. After this, proceed to Ganshu as normal. Another option using a party with strong spiking skills and speed boosts is to run west from [[The Marketplace]], ignoring the enemies along the way until you reach the westernmost bridge from the main landmass to the island containing the [[Jade Brotherhood]] guild hall. Using this bridge, run north and west past two packs of enemies until you reach a small courtyard with a central dais within compass range just south of Ganshu. Prepare, flag heroes (possibly locking targets for shutdown), precast spirits and protective spells as necessary and then spike down Ganshu. Pick up the text when Ganshu dies and you may freely resign or map out. These tactics work even with small party sizes (where they benefit greatly from accompanying summoned allies). It is also worth noting that Ganshu does not pull with either of the packs to his immediate west and south. If you lack the means to fight him with his allies, you can pull the west pack first and then pull Ganshu independently for an easy kill. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s ([[Canthan]]s) *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Canthan Peasant]] *{{r}} 20 (20) Canthan Peasant *{{mo}} 20 (20) Canthan Peasant *{{a}} 20 (20) Canthan Peasant Humans ([[Ministry of Purity]]) *{{mo}} 28 [[Xan Hei]] *{{w}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Enforcer]] *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Enforcer]] *{{r}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Ranger]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Ranger]] *{{mo}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Cleric]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Cleric]] *{{n}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Purger]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Purger]] *{{me}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Illusionist]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Illusionist]] *{{e}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Mage]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Mage]] *{{a}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Bladesman]] *{{a}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Bladesman]] *{{rt}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Medium]] *{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Medium]] *{{p}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Captain]] *{{p}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Captain]] *{{d}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Zealot]] *{{d}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Zealot]] ===Foes=== Humans ([[Jade Brotherhood]]) *{{w}}{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Warrior]] *{{r}}{{a}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ranger]] *{{mo}}{{d}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Monk]] *{{n}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Necromancer]] *{{me}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mesmer]] *{{e}}{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Elementalist]] *{{a}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Assassin]] *{{rt}}{{p}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ritualist]] ====Bosses==== Humans (Jade Brotherhood) *{{mo}} 26 (30) [[Ganshu the Scribe]] → [[Life Sheath]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Xan Hei :''"I trust that you will join us in our next operation.
